elements.name: Guild Hall
elements.about: The guild's great hall, hung with the badges of every squadron; pilots meet here for guild assemblies, elections and to honour pilots lost in service.

elements.name: Hall of Wings
elements.about: A gallery of famous craft and pilots' portraits, open to visitors.

elements.name: Cloister
elements.about: A quiet cloister garden for members.
